name: TIC 364541950
description: A red giant observed by TESS, 15.3 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,203 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.92 solar masses and 15.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,344 K at its surface.
